name: Xebio Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Xebio Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the retail of sporting goods, equipment, and apparel in Japan. It operates integrated mega specialty stores under The Super Sports XEBIO brand; small and medium-sized sports specialty stores under the XEBIO Sports Express and NEXAS brand; urban sporting goods specialty stores under the Victoria brand; sporting goods specialty stores under the Takeda Sports brand; golf products specialty stores under the Victoria Golf and Golf Partner brands; specialty outdoor shop under the L-Breath brand; and casual sportswear shop under the X'tyle brands.
